threats.threatDescription: Process identity spoofing — attacker impersonates a legitimate process
threats.attackDescription: Attacker injects requests pretending to be a legitimate caller
threats.causeDescription: Insufficient process authentication — callers are not required to prove their identity

threats.threatDescription: Undefined fail-safe output state — process outputs reach arbitrary values on communication loss
threats.attackDescription: Attacker disrupts communication; without a defined fail-safe state, outputs may drive actuators dangerously
threats.causeDescription: No deterministic fail-safe output state defined — actuator outputs are unpredictable under fault

threats.threatDescription: Process action repudiation — process denies having performed an action
threats.attackDescription: Process or its operator denies having executed a command that affected the system
threats.causeDescription: Audit log is absent, incomplete, or not tamper-proof

threats.threatDescription: Process data leakage — sensitive data processed by the process is exposed
threats.attackDescription: Attacker observes process output and extracts sensitive configuration data, credentials, or business information
threats.causeDescription: Process outputs or error messages contain sensitive information — no output filtering applied

threats.threatDescription: Process resource exhaustion — attacker exhausts process resources causing denial of service
threats.attackDescription: Attacker sends high volume of requests consuming all available CPU, memory, or file handles
threats.causeDescription: No resource limits or rate limiting — process allocates unbounded resources in response to requests

threats.threatDescription: Secure boot bypass on embedded system — attacker bypasses firmware signature verification
threats.attackDescription: Attacker disables Secure Boot to execute malicious firmware that persists across device resets
threats.causeDescription: Secure Boot is not enforced or can be bypassed via debug interface

threats.threatDescription: Embedded storage tampering — attacker modifies data in non-volatile memory
threats.attackDescription: Attacker uses debug interface to modify firmware, configuration, or calibration data
threats.causeDescription: Flash/EEPROM/NVRAM storage lacks access control or integrity protection

threats.threatDescription: Data store access repudiation — access to the data store cannot be attributed
threats.attackDescription: Attacker accesses the data store and denies having done so because no log entry exists
threats.causeDescription: No access logging on the data store

threats.threatDescription: Embedded storage information disclosure — attacker reads sensitive data from non-volatile memory
threats.attackDescription: Attacker reads non-volatile memory to extract firmware, cryptographic keys, or sensitive configuration
threats.causeDescription: Flash/EEPROM/NVRAM lacks readback protection — stored keys and credentials are readable

threats.threatDescription: Data store unavailability — attacker makes the data store inaccessible
threats.attackDescription: Attacker fills the data store to capacity or corrupts its index causing all operations to fail
threats.causeDescription: No redundancy for data store access — single point of failure

threats.threatDescription: Physical boundary identity spoofing — attacker impersonates authorized personnel to gain physical access
threats.attackDescription: Attacker impersonates an authorized person (e.g. maintenance technician) to gain physical access to the boundary interior
threats.causeDescription: Physical access control relies on single-factor authentication — no second factor prevents impersonation

threats.threatDescription: Physical boundary tampering — unauthorized physical access to boundary interior
threats.attackDescription: Attacker opens the enclosure without triggering any alarm, gaining access to internal components
threats.causeDescription: No tamper detection mechanism — unauthorized opening is undetected

threats.threatDescription: Physical access without audit trail — actions at physical boundary cannot be attributed
threats.attackDescription: Attacker accesses boundary and performs actions without any record being created
threats.causeDescription: No physical monitoring or access logging at boundary — who accessed it and when is unknown

threats.threatDescription: Side-channel observation — sensitive data extracted via physical measurements
threats.attackDescription: Attacker measures power consumption or EM emissions and extracts cryptographic keys
threats.causeDescription: Physical boundary provides no electromagnetic shielding — internal operations are observable

threats.threatDescription: Physical destruction or power disruption — device rendered unavailable by physical attack

threats.causeDescription: No physical protection or anchoring — device can be damaged, unplugged, or destroyed

threats.threatDescription: Physical privilege escalation — attacker gains elevated system access via physical boundary breach

threats.causeDescription: Physical access to device interior grants debug/hardware access — logical security can be bypassed
